title: Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, Mexican Drug Lord, Dies in Prison
summary_full: Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, who helped build the foundations of modern-day drug empires, was the subject of a major U.S. manhunt for his role in the murder of a D.E.A. agent.
